sql.workType.getTypesForCompany: select id, company_id, work_type, archived from flow.work_type where company_id = :companyId and archived is not true
sql.workType.getType: select id, company_id, work_type, archived from flow.work_type where id = :id
sql.workType.deleteType: update flow.work_type set archived = true where id = :id
sql.workType.updateType: update flow.work_type set work_type = :workType where id = :id
